reviews.review:
Mixed feelings about Hemera. On the one hand, the atmosphere, with its rich textures and colors, is impressive. The narrative is captivating, or at least engaging, without being overly predictable.
On the downside, I found some minor bugs, which forced me to repeat certain sections, making it somewhat tedious.
Also felt it could have made better use of the mobile phone conversations.
The combat is not good or bad, its simple, yet adds some dynamism to what would otherwise be a more conventional walking simulator.
In short, Hemera, with its ups and downs, has elements that make it worth experiencing, so if you’re looking for a game that’s not so much horror but mystery with symbolism, and its atmospheric graphics appeals to you, I recommend buying it when on sale.

From what I’ve seen, the dev is working on a new game called PANAME, to keep an eye on.
